challenges.headline: Of 11,069 relations, 88 weak links form a 79-node layer that random edges never produce. Three of the four tipped entities sit inside it.
Five of twelve AI-predicted link bundles hold up against the real trade records. 8 company pairs look like a business shutting down and reopening under a new name.
The register's giant network is mostly people who happen to share common names. The real anomalies are small fishing-named groups with shared owners; 2 are flagged Suspect.
